description: Capability for the main window. The fs commands are scoped ONCE via fs:scope rather than per-permission: tauri-plugin-fs unions the global scope with each command scope, so one declaration is the whole story and there is no per-command list to drift. $HOME plus /Volumes covers every real working folder (client sources live under ~/Library/CloudStorage/*, an external drive or network mount appears under /Volumes) while excluding /etc, /usr, /private and the system Library. requireLiteralLeadingDot is set to false in tauri.conf.json's fs plugin config — NOT here; the plugin reads it only from there, it defaults to true on unix, and without it these globs would not match `.dchub.json`, which is the asset identity manifest.
